name: mahdyarief
description: Plugins by mahdyarief: slideck-html (single-file HTML slide decks) and web-access (web search, URL extraction, GitHub search via local MCP server).

plugins.name: slideck-html
plugins.description: Build and edit stable single-file HTML slide decks with the frozen slideck-html template system. Provides the slideck-html skill (designs, themes, motions, placeholder layouts, autofit, SVG charts, concept diagrams, icons, shapes, Mermaid flowcharts, PPTX import/export, HTML to PDF, node build.js, node check.js).

plugins.name: web-access
plugins.description: Web access for OpenClaude: web search (Exa/Tavily with API key rotation), URL content extraction, site map/crawl, and GitHub search via a local MCP server. Bypasses built-in WebSearch/WebFetch.
